note: Needs more evidence. The exact current Swatch US/Spain pages and EAN-linked authorized/secondary records establish a homogeneous White Classiness SS08K102-S14 configuration, current under-$300 pricing, 34 mm round case, 38 mm wearing span, 4.3 mm primary thickness, 12 g full mass, quartz operation, 3 bar resistance, biosourced materials, proprietary Swatch pin attachment, and no-date display. The newly retrieved exact Louis Pion page corroborates the EAN, 34 mm dimensions, two-hand quartz display, and approximately 12 g mass but publishes no rate or lume evidence. The 3.9 mm secondary thickness is retained only as a conflict. A source-led search found an exact authorized-retailer snippet labelling luminescence absent, but direct retrieval is anti-bot blocked, so it cannot close lumeGrade. No numerical rate bound is published for the exact SW-SF installation; accuracy and lume therefore remain open and the row stays research-only.
